summary.text: David Sessions, a Republican, has represented District 35 in the Alabama State Senate since November 7, 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Sessions graduated from Mobile County High School in 1978, and his professional experience includes working as a farmer, co-owning Sessions Farm, and serving as president of Grand Bay Water Works and Producers Gin Company LLC.
